label: PIPELINE TEST (scripted model, not Gemma)
harness: official swegemma 0.2.7 Evaluator, subprocess sandbox, macOS/py3.12
scenario: V1.3 edit channel: run_command heredoc writes the new code to /tmp, code-edit 'lines ... @/tmp/file' applies it. First a deliberate off-by-one (NEW repeats the line above START), then the correct call. The new code contains double quotes inside a docstring.
result: off-by-one refused with 'Use START=56'; correct call EDITED with quotes byte-exact; tests pass; review READY; graded resolved.
found_and_fixed: First attempt (same steps) NOT resolved: edit.py could not see /tmp/new.txt. The subprocess sandbox rewrites /tmp in run_command text to <sandbox>/tmp (=$TMPDIR) but cannot rewrite skill arguments (swegemma/sandbox/subprocess.py exec). edit.py and diagnose.py now fall back to $TMPDIR. Docker sandbox: /tmp is shared, unaffected.
notes: Proves the channel works end to end in the official harness. Says nothing about how often real Gemma uses it or gets line numbers right.
